caption: The drawing depicts a single elongated, hexagonal bottle lying horizontally on a plain, beige background. The body of the bottle is blue with faceted edges. On the left end of the bottle is a round, gold-colored cap that is open, with a small, clear stopper lying next to it. The right end of the bottle features a gold-colored, ribbed, and slightly flared neck or base. Subtle ochre-colored shading appears beneath and behind the bottle, giving a slight impression of a ground or surface, while the rest of the space is unadorned.
title: Perfume Bottle
